research_mode: official ONS and Home Office sources only; current YE March 2026 crime and outcomes measurements with explicit survey, recording, cohort-maturity and transition limitations; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Non-victim median outcome days
verified_claims: median time to outcome was 17 days
this was 2 days lower than the previous year
limitations: median timing hides variation between offence types

sources.name: Non-victim charge timing
verified_claims: charge or summons outcomes took a median 40 days
the previous-year median was 47 days
limitations: timing does not control for case complexity

sources.name: Drug charge timing
verified_claims: drug charge or summons timing fell from 62 to 53 days
limitations: the metric is a median outcome-timing measure

sources.name: Weapons charge timing
verified_claims: possession-of-weapons charge timing fell from 22 to 18 days
limitations: the metric does not measure offence severity or local risk

sources.name: Public-order charge timing
verified_claims: public-order charge timing fell from 36 to 28 days
limitations: recording and case mix can affect the comparison

sources.name: Firearm charge rate
verified_claims: 12.9% of firearm offences resulted in charge or summons
the previous-year figure was 12.0%
limitations: firearm offences are a selected subset of recorded offences

sources.name: Knife charge rate
verified_claims: 13.0% of knife-enabled offences resulted in charge or summons
the previous-year figure was 11.5%
the equivalent non-knife rate was 7.5%
limitations: the compared groups differ in composition and seriousness

sources.name: Violence victim non-support
verified_claims: 41.4% of violence-against-the-person offences closed because victims did not support action
the previous-year figure was 42.5%
limitations: victim non-support is an outcome reason, not proof about offence validity

sources.name: Domestic-abuse non-support comparison
verified_claims: 58.4% of domestic-abuse-related violence closed because the victim did not support further action
the non-domestic figure was 36.9%
limitations: figures refer to year ending March 2025 contextual data

sources.name: Domestic-abuse charge comparison
verified_claims: domestic-abuse-related violence had a 7.3% charge rate
non-domestic violence had a 5.7% charge rate
limitations: figures refer to year ending March 2025 contextual data

sources.name: Domestic-abuse suspect identification
verified_claims: 1.8% of domestic-abuse-related violence closed with no suspect identified
the non-domestic figure was 19.5%

sources.name: Violence injury charge comparison
verified_claims: violence with injury had an 8.6% charge rate
violence without injury had a 6.7% charge rate
limitations: offence seriousness and evidence mix differ

sources.name: Homicide charge rate
verified_claims: 61.5% of homicide offences had a charge or summons outcome
the previous-year figure was 55.9%
limitations: recent homicide cohorts remain partly under investigation

sources.name: Homicide cohort maturation
verified_claims: 36.4% of homicides recorded in year ending March 2023 were initially still under investigation
the latest share fell to 7.9%
limitations: cohort maturity must accompany outcome-rate comparisons

sources.name: Homicide charge maturation
verified_claims: the March 2023 homicide cohort charge rate rose from 58.2% at first publication to 77.6% in updated data
limitations: later cohort updates must not be mixed with initial snapshots
